title: Indian Curry Potatoes
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make gluten-free dish, combining the warmth of Indian spices with the comfort of potatoes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the curry leaves and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for another minute.
Add the potatoes, tomato, salt, and water, and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir occasionally to prevent the potatoes from sticking to the pan.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
